start: Owner signed in; a member paid a fee today

steps.action: Open a payment's receipt from Money or from the member's page
user_sees: Title 'Receipt {number}', subtitle '{member} · {day}'
Buttons 'Back', 'Send on WhatsApp', 'Print'
On the paper: gym name, address, phone, 'GSTIN: …' when saved, the receipt number and day
'Received with thanks from', the member's name and phone
'Particulars' and 'Amount', then 'Total received' with the amount in figures and in words
With GST: a box 'Tax included in the above' with 'Taxable value', 'CGST @ {n}%', 'SGST @ {n}%'
'Paid by {method}'
must_not: A total that differs from the payment
Taxable value plus CGST plus SGST not adding up to the total
Another member's name
Another branch's receipt number

steps.action: Tap 'Print'
user_sees: The browser's print preview with the paper only
must_not: The Back, WhatsApp and Print buttons on the print
A dark page printed in dark mode

steps.action: Tap 'Back'
user_sees: The page the person came from, or Money when there is none
must_not: The panel closes or leaves the site

start: Owner on a receipt; the other thing the page does

steps.action: On a receipt of a member with a valid phone number, with internet, tap 'Send on WhatsApp' (do not press send to a real person)
user_sees: WhatsApp opens for that member's number with a ready message: 'we received your ₹{amount} on {day} ({method}). Receipt no. {number}. … Thank you!'
When a balance is left: the message also carries what is still due and the pay link
must_not: A message sent by itself
Another member's number
A pay link when nothing is due
A wrong still-due amount

start: Owner opens receipts that cannot be shown or sent in full

steps.action: Open the address of a receipt that does not exist
user_sees: 'Receipt not found'
'This receipt is not here any more. It may be from a gym you erased.'
Button 'Back to Money'
must_not: A blank page
An empty receipt with ₹0

steps.action: Open a receipt of a member with no valid phone number
user_sees: No 'Send on WhatsApp' button
must_not: A button that opens WhatsApp with no number

steps.action: Open a receipt with the internet off
user_sees: No 'Send on WhatsApp' button; 'Print' still works
must_not: A dead button

steps.action: Open a receipt whose save got no answer because the internet dropped
user_sees: 'Print' is greyed
'Not confirmed yet: the internet dropped while this was saved. Its receipt number is sure once it is sent, so print it after that.'
must_not: A print with a number that may change
A 'Send on WhatsApp' button that sends the unsure number to the member

start: Owner with a receipt that is later cancelled

steps.action: Cancel (void) a payment with a reason, then open its receipt
user_sees: A boxed banner on the paper: 'CANCELLED — THIS RECEIPT DOES NOT COUNT' with the reason under it
No 'Send on WhatsApp' button
must_not: The receipt looking valid
The banner only as a colour that a black-and-white printer loses

steps.action: Tap 'Print'
user_sees: The banner is on the print
must_not: A cancelled receipt printed without the banner

start: Owner of a gym with two branches; a receipt of branch 2

steps.action: Open the receipt
user_sees: A number that starts with the branch's own code
Only this member's name and phone
must_not: The same number as a receipt of branch 1
Other payments of the member that are not part of this receipt
Internal notes

steps.action: Tap 'Send on WhatsApp'
user_sees: WhatsApp opens only for the member's own number
must_not: The receipt offered to any other number
